title: Actual Use Trial of Atorvastatin Calcium 10 mg

sections.abstract:
The purpose of this actual use study is to simulate the over the counter use of atorvastatin calcium 10 mg.

Posted outcomes: Percentage of Participants Who Complied With the Direction to Check Their Low-density Lipoprotein Cholesterol (LDL-C) Level. timeframe=Day 1 up to Week 26. Atorvastatin=49.7
